name: Kuranaka Sana
source:
A first-year student at Seifu Academy. Airi’s best friend. A virgin.
Her grades are average, but she’s terrible at sports.
She met Airi back in elementary school, when Airi was an outcast, and they’ve been friends ever since.
She seems to envy the fact that Airi’s new father is a university professor.
She’s a member of the video club and wants to shoot a music video starring Airi.
She has an average bust size.

[Translated and edited from [url=https://gyutto.com/i/item13052?select_uaflag=1]Gyutto[/url]]
